name: moonshine-monorepo
description: Moonshine — hyperminimal Bun-first UI runtime; import-what-you-need signals + host adapters

scripts.test: bun test packages components && bun run check:catalog
scripts.typecheck: bunx tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --noEmit -p packages/crepus-moonshine/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --noEmit -p packages/adapter-solid/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --noEmit -p components/tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck:native: bunx tsgo --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && bunx tsgo --noEmit -p packages/crepus-moonshine/tsconfig.json && bunx tsgo --noEmit -p packages/adapter-solid/tsconfig.json && bunx tsgo --noEmit -p components/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run check:catalog
